# lab01 image assets

This directory is reserved for generated raster assets for `apps/design-prompts/lab01`.

Generation was prepared from the local lab references (`1.png`, `2.png`, `3.png`) and the existing `index.html` visual system:

- premium editorial wellness
- clinical botanical nutrition
- warm cream/off-white surfaces
- deep forest green accents
- muted sage-gray supporting copy
- soft natural photography
- restrained luxury spacing and card surfaces

- `hero-food-bowl.png`
- `hero-botanical-portrait.png`
- `nutrition-shake-card.png`
- `ingredient-olive-leaf.png`
- `ingredient-fermented-tonics.png`

Use `asset-prompts.jsonl` as the generation queue. Each line contains a stable `filename` and a production prompt.
